body: See the module body in the message above (helpers, CHK-013..CHK-017 assertions and hit counters).
notes: Not compiled or simulated. Assumptions: AHB reads and writes are pipelined with a single outstanding data phase; B responses return in AXI write order; and fewer than 256 write beats are outstanding at once (history arrays are 256-entry circular). A "rejected" write inside a burst is not renumbered.
